summary: This clinical trial compared two medications, empagliflozin and dapagliflozin, to see how well they lower protein leakage in the urine of patients with type 2 diabetes and long-term kidney disease. The study looked at changes in urine protein levels, blood sugar, kidney function, and treatment costs over four months. The sponsor for this completed study was Lahore General Hospital, and it included 116 participants.
